<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<definitions xmlns="https://www.omg.org/spec/DMN/20191111/MODEL/" id="definitions" name="definitions" namespace="http://camunda.org/schema/1.0/dmn">
  <decision id="decision" name="Mortgage Product Assignment">
    <decisionTable id="decisionTable" hitPolicy="FIRST">
      <input id="input-1" label="application.creditScore">
        <inputExpression id="input-1-exp" typeRef="number" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>application.creditScore</text>
        </inputExpression>
      </input>
      <input id="input-2" label="dti">
        <inputExpression id="input-2-exp" typeRef="number" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>if application.dti != null then application.dti else if application.income.grossMonthly != null and application.income.grossMonthly > 0 and application.housing != null then ((if application.housing.principalInterest != null then application.housing.principalInterest else 0) + (if application.housing.taxes != null then application.housing.taxes else 0) + (if application.housing.insurance != null then application.housing.insurance else 0) + (if application.housing.hoa != null then application.housing.hoa else 0) + (if application.housing.mip != null then application.housing.mip else 0) + (if application.debts != null then sum(for d in application.debts return (if d.include = false or d.monthlyPayment = null then 0 else d.monthlyPayment)) else 0)) / application.income.grossMonthly * 100 else null</text>
        </inputExpression>
      </input>
      <input id="input-3" label="ltv">
        <inputExpression id="input-3-exp" typeRef="number" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>if application.ltv != null then application.ltv else if application.loan.amount != null and application.collateral.appraisedValue != null and application.collateral.appraisedValue > 0 then application.loan.amount / (if application.purpose = "purchase" and application.collateral.purchasePrice != null then min(application.collateral.purchasePrice, application.collateral.appraisedValue) else application.collateral.appraisedValue) * 100 else null</text>
        </inputExpression>
      </input>
      <input id="input-4" label="application.fixedPreference">
        <inputExpression id="input-4-exp" typeRef="boolean" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>application.fixedPreference</text>
        </inputExpression>
      </input>
      <input id="input-5" label="application.rateSensitivity">

        </inputExpression>
      </input>
      <input id="input-6" label="application.horizonYears">
        <inputExpression id="input-6-exp" typeRef="number" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>application.horizonYears</text>
        </inputExpression>
      </input>
      <input id="input-7" label="application.incomeStability">
        <inputExpression id="input-7-exp" typeRef="string" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>application.incomeStability</text>
        </inputExpression>
      </input>
      <output id="output-1" label="product" name="product" typeRef="string" />
      <rule id="rule-1">
        <inputEntry id="rule-1-input-1">
          <text><640</text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-1-input-2">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-1-input-3">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-1-input-4">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-1-input-5">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-1-input-6">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-1-input-7">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <outputEntry id="rule-1-output-1">
          <text>"ManualReview"</text>
        </outputEntry>
      </rule>
      <rule id="rule-2">
        <inputEntry id="rule-2-input-1">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-2-input-2">
          <text>>50</text>
        </inputEntry>

        </inputEntry>

        </inputEntry>

          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-3-input-6">

        </inputEntry>
